The '''Vaal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[hyenax]] and site of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Relay Outpost V-798|relay outpost V-798]]. The planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around its [[Star/Legends|sun]] intersected several [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]], [[Vaal asteroid field|one of which]] contained the [[Rukabi Major]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].

==Description==
A [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the Vaal system<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]],<ref name="The Savage Heart" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of feral, [[Dog/Legends|dog]]-like creatures known as [[hyenax]].<ref name="hyenax" /> [[Orbit/Legends|Orbited]] by a [[Vaal's moon|moon]], Vaal's trajectory around its [[Star/Legends|sun]] intersected several [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]],<ref name="The Savage Heart" /> [[Vaal asteroid field|one of which]] contained the [[Rukabi Major]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="A Holiday from Hutta" /> This made any approach to the planet trecherous at best, and because of its regular passages through the aseroids, Vaal was often struck by meteors and other chunks of debris.<ref name="Vaal">{{CSWECite|III|287-288|Vaal}}</ref> The Vaal system was connected to the [[Glade system/Legends|Glade]] and [[Jovan system/Legends|Jovan systems]] by the [[Wetyin's Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], and to the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] by the [[Yavin Bypass/Legends|Yavin Bypass]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] life form [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]] came into the possession of [[Glorzo]], a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] collector on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. While the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tharan Cedrax]] made the Hutt a generous offer for her, he had already made a deal with a [[Unidentified scavenger|scavenger]]. Seeing an opportunity for amusement, Glorzo proposed a contest: Cedrax and the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] would enter the Vaal asteroid field, and the first to bring back a stone from Rukabi Major would win possession of Holiday. Despite the scavenger's clever [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]], Cedrax knew certain navigational algorithms that allowed him to retrieve the stone first, which he exchanged for Holiday after returning to Nal Hutta [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before the scavenger.<ref name="A Holiday from Hutta" />

In the years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a [[Imperial Relay Outpost V-798|relay outpost]] on Vaal, the legacy of a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who hoped to make the planet into a destination for [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] escaped the destruction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]], which sustained damage during the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] that disabled its communications and limited its [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] navigation capabilities. As a result,<ref name="The Savage Heart" /> Vader was forced to limp<ref name="TNEC" /> to the only Imperial outpost in range, relay outpost V-798 on Vaal. However, he crash landed on the planet's surface when his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was damaged by a [[Meteorite/Legends|metiorite]] upon exiting hyperspace in the Vaal system's asteroid fields.<ref name="The Savage Heart" />

Circa [[25 BBY/Legends|25 ABY]], the Vaal system had a population of less than 1,000,000.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vaal system first appeared, albeit unidentified, in [[Empire 14|''Empire'' 14]], a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] comic written by [[David Land]] (credited as Paul Alden) and pencilled by [[Raúl Treviño]]<ref name="The Savage Heart" /> that was released on [[December 10]], [[2003]].<ref name="The Savage Heart release date">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-385/Star-Wars-Empire-14The-Savage-Heart|text=Star Wars: Empire #14 The Savage Heart}}</ref> It was first identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA" /> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square P-5.<ref name="TEA" />
